name: Lithuania
tagline: Two doors, and one opens after results day
ownCitizens: If you hold Lithuanian citizenship, the parts of this page written for other EU/EEA citizens — registering your right of residence, proving your fee status — are not about you, and Lithuania's own student grants and loans are open to you on their ordinary terms; check them, because some depend on where you have lived. Your IB is still a foreign qualification here, so the IB entry rules on this page still apply to you.
summary: Lithuania has two ways in for an EU student. Apply to the university directly for a fee-paying place, on its own calendar — or apply through LAMA BPO, the joint admission system, for a state-funded place. LAMA BPO's main round has closed in late July, after IB results, and it says IB grades need no conversion.
whyConsider: EU citizens can compete for state-funded places on English-taught programmes, including at Vilnius University.
The joint round has closed after IB results are published, so you can apply knowing your grades.
watchOuts: At Vilnius University, English-taught Medicine and Dentistry are not state-funded; they are applied for directly and paid for.
The 2027 LAMA BPO schedule is not yet published. In 2026 the main round ran 1 June to 23 July, and contracts had to be signed in person.
Recognition of your diploma can take a month or more. Start early.

ibRecognition.subjectLevelRule: For a state-funded place through LAMA BPO, the IB Diploma is uploaded as it is; LAMA BPO says IB subjects and grades need no conversion.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Available at most universities and at some colleges.
notes: ISM accepts an IB Diploma as proof of English.

sectorLandscape.summary: Lithuania has two kinds of higher education institution: the universitetas, which teaches university-level degrees and does research, and the kolegija, which teaches college-level professional degrees and does applied research. The kolegija is the more practical route, and some teach programmes in English.

routes.what: University-level bachelor's and integrated degrees — Vilnius, KTU, LSMU, VMU, VILNIUS TECH and others. Where most English-taught bachelor's and English-taught Medicine sit.
College-level professional study with placements. Kauno kolegija, for example, admits EU applicants to English-taught programmes through its own portal, 1 December to 1 June.
routes.note: Other kolegijos set their own windows; check each one's admissions page.

notes: Not established: how the LAMA BPO competitive score is built from IB grades; how many choices it allows; which English-taught programmes outside Vilnius University carry state-funded places.
Unreconciled: LAMA BPO says IB grades need no conversion, while Vilnius University says SKVC determines subject equivalents for foreign qualifications.
